description.zh: 快照ID。取值：极速型NAS高级型成功创建快照后，获得快照 ID。
description.en: The snapshot ID. Set this parameter to the snapshot ID obtained after a snapshot is successfully created for an Advanced Extreme NAS file system.

title.zh: 删除快照或取消正在创建的快照任务
title.en: Delete a snapshot or cancel a snapshot task that is being created
